# ☕ Kaapi Bricks Koramangala — Daily Prep Plan
**STR-001 | Tuesday, 29 September 2026**

---

## 🌦️ Situation Summary

| Factor | Detail | Ops Impact |
|---|---|---|
| Weather | Thunderstorm, 21–28°C, 21mm rain | Strong hot-drink shift expected |
| Day Type | Regular Tuesday | Baseline volume applies |
| Holiday | None today | No multiplier |
| Nearby Festival | Gandhi Jayanti on 02 Oct (Fri) | No impact today |

> **Bottom line:** A rainy Tuesday with no holiday. Expect volume close to your Tuesday baseline of **56 orders / ₹8,246**, with a meaningful shift *away* from cold drinks and *toward* hot, comforting options. No volume multiplier applies.

---

## ☕ Product Forecast for Today

*Baseline units adjusted for thunderstorm weather (hot drinks +15–20%, cold drinks −30–40%)*

| Drink | Typical Tuesday | Today's Forecast | Direction | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Classic Filter Coffee | 12.1 | **14–15** | ⬆️ +15–20% | Rain comfort drink #1 |
| Strong Decoction | 9.8 | **11–12** | ⬆️ +15–20% | Bold & warming, rainy-day favourite |
| Masala Chai | 8.5 | **10–11** | ⬆️ +20–25% | Biggest rain beneficiary |
| Degree Coffee | 6.5 | **7–8** | ⬆️ +10–15% | Steady hot performer |
| Bella Kaapi (Jaggery) | 5.0 | **6–7** | ⬆️ +15–20% | Warm, earthy — suits cold/wet feel |
| Mysore Filter Coffee | 4.7 | **5–6** | ⬆️ +10–15% | Moderate uplift |
| Cold Coffee | 3.6 | **2–3** | ⬇️ −30–35% | Rain suppresses cold orders sharply |
| Kumbakonam Degree Coffee | 3.5 | **4–5** | ⬆️ +10–15% | Hot variant holds well |

> **Prep priority order:** Masala Chai → Classic Filter Coffee → Strong Decoction → Bella Kaapi → Degree Coffee

---

## 👥 Staffing Recommendation

| Shift | Recommendation |
|---|---|
| **Opening (7–10 AM)** | Full crew — rain during morning commute drives early café shelter visits |
| **Midday (11 AM–2 PM)** | Standard Tuesday staffing |
| **Afternoon (3–6 PM)** | Keep one extra hand on standby — thunderstorms often intensify in Bangalore afternoons, creating a second shelter-in rush |
| **Evening (6–9 PM)** | Standard; monitor weather; if storm continues, expect a slow tail-off |

**Overall:** No volume multiplier today, but the *drink mix* is more labour-intensive (filter coffee and chai require more active prep than cold drinks). Don't thin the crew.

---

## 🧾 Inventory Watch

### ⚠️ Stock Cover — Monitor Closely

| Item | Stock | Cover | Today's Risk |
|---|---|---|---|
| Chikmagalur Robusta Beans | 69.93 kg | **18.2 days** | 🔴 Tightest cover. Rain day = higher hot coffee volume. Watch closely. |
| Almond Milk | 67.49 L | 28.2 days | 🟡 Comfortable today, but cold-drink suppression helps |
| Chicory | 45.06 kg | 31.1 days | 🟢 Fine for today |
| Rose Syrup | 16.79 L | 35.0 days | 🟢 Fine for today |

> **Action:** With Robusta Beans at only 18 days of cover and hot drink demand elevated today, flag this for an urgent reorder if not already in progress.

---

## 🚨 Overdue Purchase Orders — Escalation Required

You have **5 significantly overdue POs** totalling **₹18,356.34**. These are not routine delays.

| PO | Supplier | Overdue | Amount |
|---|---|---|---|
| PO-01559 | Organic Alternatives India | **208 days** 🔴 | ₹4,742.60 |
| PO-01654 | Kerala Spice Traders | **198 days** 🔴 | ₹2,924.47 |
| PO-00343 | Araku Valley Organics | **196 days** 🔴 | ₹2,207.56 |
| PO-00816 | Mysore Sweet Works | **156 days** 🔴 | ₹6,017.21 |
| PO-00791 | Mysore Sweet Works | **116 days** 🔴 | ₹2,464.50 |

> ⚠️ **Kerala Spice Traders** supplies spices relevant to **Masala Chai** — your biggest rain-day winner. With PO-01654 nearly 200 days overdue, verify your spice blend stock *today* before the morning rush.
>
> ⚠️ **Mysore Sweet Works** has *two* overdue POs (₹8,481.71 combined). If they supply jaggery or sweeteners, this directly affects **Bella Kaapi** — a drink you'll push today.
>
> 📌 Escalate all 5 POs to your procurement/ops manager immediately. These are not store-level resolvable delays.

---

## 📋 Today's Action Checklist

- [ ] Pre-brew extra decoction batches for Classic Filter, Strong Decoction, and Kumbakonam Degree Coffee before 8 AM
- [ ] Prep Masala Chai spice mix in larger-than-usual quantity
- [ ] Verify Bella Kaapi jaggery stock (given Mysore Sweet Works PO delays)
- [ ] Verify Masala Chai spice blend stock (given Kerala Spice Traders PO delay)
- [ ] Flag Robusta Beans reorder to procurement today
- [ ] Reduce Cold Coffee pre-prep — don't over-stock cold brew or ice
- [ ] Ensure umbrellas/cover near entrance — wet customers need quick service
- [ ] Escalate all 5 overdue POs to ops/procurement manager
